method: Built-in image_gen; one asset per scene
shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium detailed dimensional illustrated circular scene FRAME OVERLAY, not a scene. Square transparent PNG. Genuine alpha transparency in entire empty CENTER and OUTSIDE. Front-on view, concentric circular opening centered at exact canvas center (50%,50%). Continuous opaque inner rim at radius 35% canvas width; hoop and all ornaments within radius 48%. Inner circular area radius 35% COMPLETELY EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Keep all decorations on rim, no figures, no scenery, no background, no text, no watermark or checkerboard. Keep 4-to-5-o'clock rim relatively thin for a settings button. Design must match the colors and environmental motifs of the named scene; school-friendly refined collectible craftsmanship. Design:
